reviews.text:
Great, but one thing…. I like this app it’s really great. There are flashcards or just a list of all the questions and the answers (that are easy to understand). (Only thing is unless an explanation is in the answer or you find it in the manual there aren’t any actual explanations.) You can even access the actually NYS Driving Manual right on the app. There is a statistic option to view your progress and how well you’re doing. The marathon test has 208 questions and the practice test has 20. What is bothering me is that the practice test keeps cutting me off at 14 questions and then showing me my grade. But when I go to my statistics almost all my tests are unfinished because I was unable to answer all 20 questions.
Otherwise it’s great and the only thing that you would have to pay for is no ads. Which the ads aren’t that bad you can skip them within 5 seconds and most of them are other practice test apps.
